question: Что такое LEFT JOIN и как это работает?
short_answer: `LEFT JOIN` preserves every left row and fills right-side columns with NULL when no match exists.
junior_answer: `LEFT JOIN` preserves every left row and fills right-side columns with NULL when no match exists. Right-table filters in ON affect which matches attach; the same filter in WHERE can remove NULL-extended rows and effectively turn the result into INNER JOIN. Важное ограничение: Count a nullable right primary key, not `COUNT(*)`, when measuring related rows per left entity.
follow_up_question: Какая типичная ошибка связана с LEFT JOIN?
follow_up_answer: Putting `right.active = true` in WHERE unexpectedly removes left rows with no active relation.
